rules.homes: adopted block origin if the measured outline fits, else nearest free

slots.name: vmb_SW_strap_master
slots.source_prerequisite: current source pinned by exact SHA256 below
slots.pin_assignment_note: Supersedes spread 2ba5e0351 (3068 centres off-track, 95 N/S PG projections in the q1 native gate): every bit on an actual M4/M5 routing track, M5 centres clear of the M5 PG stripe projections, explicit per-bit centres, occupancy <=0.50; clock on the N centre track. Exact per-bit centers and actual ODB pin rectangles must match; no native/route qualification inherited.
slots.scope: 270 x 270 strap master grant (H-SM accepted 22:5x). Physical qualification, parent adoption and homes OPEN.

layer_cap_grant.reason: VM bank strap masters are pin-perimeter bound (270 x 270, ~1,260 b per face): PG moves to M6 so M5 pins need no stripe clearance; parent strap M7 (H-DIE 2210, H-SM proposal)
